set.body:
Epic: bd-01KXYJK0XSA3RNH9ANMVC96EPE

Migrate connectivity, multivar, inference, graph-linalg, latent, and other eigen, SVD, generalized-eigen, and partial-spectral consumers to Gale and its SpectralBackend capability.

Explicitly adapt rather than assume parity for ascending versus descending eigen order, lower-triangle read policy, full-spectrum versus k less than n routing, V versus VT SVD orientation, repeated eigenspaces, convergence semantics, rank cutoffs, and domain error types. Verify symmetry at Scalafim trust boundaries where the domain promises it.

Acceptance
Tests cover residuals, orthogonality, B-orthonormal generalized eigenvectors, deterministic ordering and sign or subspace semantics, repeated eigenvalues, full-spectrum requests, partial convergence, and malformed or non-finite inputs on JVM and JS. R parity and independent numerical fixtures pass where ecosystem behavior is contractual. Scalafim generic spectral solver traits and portable implementations are removed after the last consumer migrates.
set.title: Scalafim Gale migration 4: spectral and multivariate solvers
